sections.title: The, not a
sections.content: So far the thing you asked for or bought was any one: *egy kenyeret*, or just *kenyeret*. When you mean one particular thing, the one both of you can see, put *a* (the) in front, or *az* before a vowel. The noun still takes *-t*: *a kenyér → a kenyeret*. Hungarian calls such an object *definite*. The next screen shows what that does to the verb.

sections.title: Any one and the particular one

sections.content: Use *a* before a consonant and *az* before a vowel, as you learned: *a tejet*, *az almát*. English says "the bread" in every role, but in Hungarian the object always carries the *-t*, with *a* or without it.
